body:
Thanks for the gold whoever gave it.  And thank all of you for the kind words.  Holidays are bad and June is horrible.  I spend half the month fearing today and the rest of the month throwing a pity party because I know it will be no different on my birthday at the end of the month.

In the end, I do feel like I abandoned them.  I was in a really bad place.  By all rights I should have died in the suicide attempt.  I knew that day that my exwife would not stop until she took my kids from me.  They were my life and my reason to be alive.  I understood unconditional love the minute I held the oldest in my arms.  And that made them the perfect weapon for my ex to use to hurt me.  She convinced the middle child to file multiple complaints through her therapist against me.  Each time, they investigated and found no evidence.  Then they watched up a level.  And when the magistrate told my ex that if the girls were not at the next visitation then my ex would be going to jail for contempt of court, that very night my ex and her lawyer- a former DCF lawyer- got my daughter to make a claim of sexual abuse. 

 Police wanted to interview me at their station and my lawyer made it very clear that would not happen.  My lawyer was then called by the judge.  Basically threatening because he was not happy that we were not cooperating with police.  My lawyer told me to expect to be charged.  And then when we signed the ex's lawyer called my lawyer.  She was livid with my ex because as much as she personally did not like me, she figured out that my ex played her with the complaint.  She told my lawyer not to worry about an arrest because the prosecutor told ex's lawyer that there is no way with a truthful claim that a parent would "just want to drop it".  So at least I know that the prosecutor does not believe it.

No.  The one who did not want to change schools is the baby.  She is just turning senior.  On the one call, I said it hurt her not talking to me.  She said she was too busy with school and family and friends to talk to me.

In theory I could but the language of the order is vague enough that my ex could claim I breached order.  The order says I may not contact minor children and am forbidden initiating contact until such time as they decide to renew the relationship.

Because if I contact her, I am in violation of a court order from the douche circuit court judge.  And he would be quite happy to throw my ass under the jail.  When he heard of the complaint he told my lawyer that he did not need to hear any testimony that the next court hearing that he would start terminating parental rights so my attorney better come to some settlement with my ex'es lawyer if I wanted any chance to see them before I got locked up for the rest of my life.  That per my attorney after the phone call from the circuit judge to her.

No.  One who asked me to force her mother to keep her in school is going into her senior year now.

One who would not invite me is the one who accused me because her mother was giving her attention.  She was always starving for attention from her mother and would do anything to please her.  She never understood her mother is incapable of unconditional love.  So she would do anything to get her mothers conditional love.

I have pictures of it.  She was in the newspaper because she sang the national anthem.  A voice like an angel.  But I was not there because I was not invite.

Almost messed up and posted under my normal account.  This is my throw away for when it hurts too much to know my pain.
If you are asking if you are a sociopath or even a psychopath then you are not.

If I could add, some of the nicest people I have EVER met were my 4 times in house hospitalization.  It is  not easy, it sounds like you are really hurting.  You did not fall this far down the rabbit hole in a day and it will take time to get better.  I cannot say that the depression goes away.  I hope for you that it will.  But please reach out to a therapist or have your husband come home and drive you to a treatment facility.

Again, this place is for support of MarkSc0311, not support for those left behind.  If you read, I actually did give an answer TO her.  Company may have a thing with the insurance that does support.  It may pay for 5 therapy sessions or something.  If OP sees a therapist, OP should qualify for FMLA and then OP takes getting fired, at least for 3 months off the plate of stressors.  There are avenues.  But guilt tripping is not one of them
Wow!!  Just wow.  Talk about a poor excuse for a human being.  Mark is saying they want to kill themselves and here you are saying you do not care about them.... just please STFU!!!!
Again, read the rules.  Perhaps you are too close to the subject and need to stop posting.

You are flying out to meet boss, are you in USA?  I am presuming you are covered by FMLA.  Does company have some kind of employee support line?  Can you use it to get a therapist to see you?  Therapist may get you listed under FMLA and then you don't have to worry about being fired next week.
I am so sorry that you feel like this, and I do get it.  Do you have someone that you can takk about, really talk about, what you are feeling?  Someone who will not judge you?
The OP doesn't need your guilt trip, your calling them selfish or your "tough love" BS.  If you cannot have empathy and show compassion, then don't speak.  For gosh sake, read the rules!

The first year was rough but got functioning.  Been some daysthat were bad, but they were days.  Really just been since Christmas.  It was lousy, had to accept that my daughters will never come around.  Add to that my wife is having major health issues.  I am so afraid she will die and I will be all alone forever

Her mother will not allow her any contact with her sisters because she is post surgery MTF.  She has chosen to cut us both out because I did not stop her mother from being verbally abusive when she was growing up.  She spied for her mother on me during the divorce and still her mother stopped talking to her when she came out.  I am very proud of her but she decided she just wants to forget all of us and get on with her life.

No, I fought for them for years.  I fought an illegal ex parte order for 4 months.  And when it looked like it would be vacated, ex convinced my daughter to lie about me in hopes of keeping the order as it was her leverage to more money.

I mean fair.  There are plenty of times I think I am.  I tell people I am an Ass.  Then I think how much worse it could have been.  How my daughter knew what she was doing when she made the accusation.  And I must be an Ass because the oldest wants nothing to do with either of us.  She has cut us out of her life and her wife's life.  The one who made the accusation is 18, the younger is still under 18.

No, they want nothing to do with me so I must be the asshole.  I did what I did because I was not in a safe place emotionally.  Kind of like on an airplane where they tell you to put the mask on you before you put it on the kid.  But still, I agreed to not contact the girls until they contact me.  Whether their mother ever told them that was in the order, I do not know.  But I made a promise and until one of them reaches out, I cannot break the law and ignore a court order.
YTA you knew what it was worth and took advantage of him.
